_comment: Executable ingestion policy (constitution §سادسًا). Tunable limits live HERE (never buried in code); the exit suite reads them from this file, while NON-NEGOTIABLE constants stay literal inside the validator (ق22). Versioned alongside the constitution + exit suite. NOTE: the kernel matching policy is a SEPARATE registry (engine/kernel/policyRegistry.js); unifying the two is a later, explicit decision — not Part 1.

ingestion._exclusion_note: ONLY these explicit policy categories may auto-grant signed_exclusion (path ب, still reviewable). Deliberately NO set/gift/box/pack/sample/tester patterns — those risk excluding a real sellable bundle (ق4: bundles are independent results). Any ambiguity -> merchant review queue (ق19, path أ), never auto-exclude.

surface._comment: Leaf display caps for surface_reachable (4-b): how many SKUs a leaf actually SURFACES (1 primary + N alternates). Read from policy, never hardcoded in a test — a test-written cap is an estimate, not a measure. Stamped with policy_version.

authoring_tree._comment: Full-tree build limits (4-b). SEMANTIC stops (exact_pool<=leaf_primary_cap; no axis passes the gate) end branching for a REASON (ق12). The min_exact_option_ratio gate rejects a mostly-compromise (weakly-grounded) axis for BRANCHING — below it the axis is descriptive, not a question. The hard limits are a SAFETY NET only: exceeding them FAILS the build explicitly (never a silent truncation).
authoring_tree._axis_rule_note: v5 axis-selection law (consultation round-5). SCORE unchanged from v4: reduction = S - (Σsᵢ² + u₀²)/S, where S = the node's EXACT-pool size |E| (a NODE property, identical for every candidate axis at the node), sᵢ = per-option EXACT count, u₀ = S - Σsᵢ the explicit UNKNOWN-on-axis residual bucket. S node-constant ⇒ ranking by max reduction == ranking by MIN integer (Σsᵢ² + u₀²) — no division/float/log. Justification = EXPECTED RESIDUAL POOL SIZE (Σsᵢ²/S = Σ(sᵢ/S)·sᵢ), not Gini. v5 changes: (1) DENOMINATOR invariant asserted per axis per node — Σsᵢ + u₀ == S (else cross-axis comparison undefined ⇒ build fails). (2) UNKNOWN-REACHABILITY invariant (server-side verifyReachability): u₀>0 ⇒ a PUBLISHED option must lead to the u₀ units (every parent-EXACT candidate stays inside some child's eligible pool); otherwise u₀² hides a reachability loss (ق2) ⇒ build fails. (3) MIRROR guard is now PER-OPTION not distributional: reject an axis whose SINGLETON SHARE (options of size 1, as a fraction of Σsᵢ) exceeds mirror_singleton_share_max — but NOT applied when S <= leaf_primary_cap+1 (an honest final binary on a tiny pool); the v4 median/density criteria are RETIRED as rejections. Tie-break unchanged: fewer options -> smaller max sᵢ -> higher axis evidence (grounding coverage) -> canonical id (last resort).
authoring_tree._mirror_exemption_note: The mirror guard is skipped when S <= leaf_primary_cap+1. NOTE (surfaced deviation): the operator's literal 'S <= leaf_primary_cap' is redundant — with leaf_primary_cap=1 such a node is already a leaf via semantic-stop-1, so it never reaches axis selection, and it would NOT exempt the operator's own S=2 accept-case. leaf_primary_cap+1 is the final binary that narrows the pool to the cap; it exempts S=2 (two distinct products = an honest question) while a large-catalog mirror (S>>cap) is still gated. Confirm or adjust this bound.
authoring_tree._unknown_axis_handling_note: For the info-gain accounting an UNGROUNDED value on the candidate axis is a SEPARATE residual bucket u₀ (excluded from every option size sᵢ), never propagated into the options. Well-defined because an ungrounded value is NEVER `exact` (exact requires SAT requires grounded). The kernel's downstream CLASSIFICATION of such a unit stays mode-dependent and UNCHANGED (a NEVER_RELAX axis rejects it; a RELAXABLE axis compromises it into every branch) — the runtime partition, separate from this design-time accounting. v5 makes the two invariants HARD: Σsᵢ + u₀ == S (partition), and u₀>0 ⇒ published reach to the u₀ units (no silent drop of a NEVER_RELAX-ungrounded exact candidate).
